name: portakal-template
description: Percentage-layout label templates on top of portakal-lite. Declarative JSON template + data → TSC/TSPL2 + ZPL II printer-ready strings, with auto-scaling layout. Device-agnostic: the label size/DPI are supplied at compile time, not stored in the template.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
